cases.case_label: Rearranged L1 (Ta) in intron 5 of CYBB
cases.mechanism_detail: An internally rearranged L1 inserted in CYBB intron 5 introduced new splice sites; two L1 fragments were spliced into transcripts as new exons with concomitant skipping of exonic coding sequence, and no wild-type cDNA was detected.
cases.quote: This resulted in a highly heterogeneous splicing pattern with introduction of two L1 fragments as new exons into the transcripts and concomitant skipping of exonic coding sequence.
